questions.q: An employee with 11 years' continuous service is being dismissed. What is the minimum notice the employer must give?
questions.es:
De 10 a 15 años de antigüedad: 6 semanas. Tabla: menos de 13 semanas, nada; hasta 2 años, 1; de 2 a 5, 2; de 5 a 10, 4; de 10 a 15, 6; más de 15, 8 semanas.
📍 Libro M3 p.14
questions.en:
10 to 15 years' service: 6 weeks. Table: less than 13 weeks, none; up to 2 years, 1; 2 to 5, 2; 5 to 10, 4; 10 to 15, 6; more than 15, 8 weeks.
📍 Book M3 p.14

questions.q: A driver has driven for 2 h 30, taken a 15-minute break, then driven another 2 hours. What break must he take now?
questions.es:
Ya lleva 4 h 30 de conducción con una pausa de 15 min: ahora le toca al menos 30 min (15 + 30 = 45). El orden siempre es 15 primero y 30 después.
📍 Libro M11 p.2
questions.en:
He has now driven 4 h 30 with a 15 min break: he must now stop for at least 30 min (15 + 30 = 45). The order is always 15 first and 30 afterwards.
📍 Book M11 p.2

questions.q: A vehicle costs €120,000, its tyres are worth €4,000 and its expected resale value after 5 years is €16,000. What is the annual straight-line depreciation?
questions.es:
(120.000 − 4.000 − 16.000) ÷ 5 = 100.000 ÷ 5 = €20.000. Los neumáticos se restan porque son coste variable; los otros resultados olvidan restar los neumáticos, el valor residual o los dos.
📍 Libro M14 p.3
questions.en:
(120,000 − 4,000 − 16,000) ÷ 5 = 100,000 ÷ 5 = €20,000. The tyres are subtracted because they are a variable cost; the other results forget the tyres, the residual value or both.
📍 Book M14 p.3

questions.q: A company cannot pay its debts and its creditors decide to wind it up. What type of winding up is this?
questions.es:
Si la empresa no puede pagar y mandan los acreedores, es creditors' voluntary. Members' voluntary es con la empresa solvente; compulsory la controlan los tribunales.
📍 Libro M2 p.12
questions.en:
If the company cannot pay and the creditors are in charge, it is a creditors' voluntary winding up. Members' voluntary is for a solvent company; compulsory is controlled by the courts.
📍 Book M2 p.12

questions.q: An operator is licensed for 4 vehicles and wants to add 2 more. How much additional financial standing must it show?
questions.es:
Cada vehículo adicional exige €5.000: 2 × 5.000 = €10.000 más (los €9.000 del primero ya están cubiertos).
📍 Libro M10 p.8
questions.en:
Each additional vehicle requires €5,000: 2 × 5,000 = €10,000 more (the €9,000 for the first is already covered).
📍 Book M10 p.8

questions.q: Current assets are €90,000, of which stock is €30,000. Current liabilities are €60,000. What is the acid test ratio?
questions.es:
Prueba ácida = (activo corriente − existencias) ÷ pasivo corriente = (90.000 − 30.000) ÷ 60.000 = 1 : 1, lo ideal. El current ratio sería 1,5 : 1.
📍 Libro M5 p.10
questions.en:
Acid test = (current assets − stock) ÷ current liabilities = (90,000 − 30,000) ÷ 60,000 = 1 : 1, the ideal. The current ratio would be 1.5 : 1.
📍 Book M5 p.10

questions.q: A driver card was last downloaded 30 days ago. What is the position?
options: Fine: only the VU is downloaded
questions.es:
La tarjeta del conductor se descarga al menos cada 28 días; la unidad del vehículo (VU), cada 90.
📍 Libro M12 p.5
questions.en:
The driver card is downloaded at least every 28 days; the vehicle unit (VU), every 90.
📍 Book M12 p.5

questions.q: An employee earning €180 a day is off sick for 4 days with a medical certificate, after 2 years' service. How much Statutory Sick Pay is due?
questions.es:
70 % de 180 = €126, pero el tope es €110 al día: 4 × 110 = €440.
📍 Libro M3 p.13-14

questions.q: At what daily noise exposure must the employer make hearing protection available (lower action value)?
questions.es:
A 80 dB(A) hay que poner los protectores a disposición y dar información y formación; a 85 dB(A) es obligatorio llevarlos y señalizar la zona; 87 dB(A) es el límite máximo.
📍 Libro M4 p.8
questions.en:
At 80 dB(A) hearing protection must be made available with information and training; at 85 dB(A) wearing it is compulsory and the area must be signposted; 87 dB(A) is the maximum limit.
📍 Book M4 p.8

questions.q: By when must a company pay its corporation tax?
options: Within 6 months after the year end
The 23rd of the 9th month after year end
By 31 October of the following year
Within 30 days after the year end
questions.es:
El impuesto de sociedades se paga como muy tarde el día 23 del noveno mes tras el cierre del ejercicio. El 31 de octubre es el plazo de los autónomos (pay and file).
📍 Libro M9 p.1
questions.en:
Corporation tax is paid at the latest on the 23rd day of the ninth month after the end of the accounting period. 31 October is the deadline for the self-employed (pay and file).
📍 Book M9 p.1

questions.q: A 13-year-old vehicle covers very few kilometres. How often must it have a safety inspection?
options: Once a year, at the CVRT
questions.es:
Según la guía de la RSA, las inspecciones van por tiempo, no por km: con 12 años o más, como máximo cada 6 semanas.
📍 Libro M13 p.5
questions.en:
According to the RSA guide, inspections are based on time, not km: at 12 years or more, at most every 6 weeks.
📍 Book M13 p.5

questions.q: A driver aged 19 holds a full category D licence and the Driver CPC. Which bus work may he do?
options: Only regular services up to 50 km
Only school runs in a minibus
questions.es:
Con 18 años, carné D y CPC completo, solo puede conducir líneas regulares de hasta 50 km. A los 21 con CPC ya no hay límite de distancia.
📍 Libro M21 p.2
questions.en:
At 18, with a D licence and the full CPC, he can only drive regular services up to 50 km. At 21 with the CPC there is no distance limit.
📍 Book M21 p.2

questions.q: Offering a tailored service to one group of customers with similar needs, such as airport transfers for executives, is an example of:
questions.es:
Segmentar es dividir el mercado en grupos con necesidades parecidas y ofrecer a cada uno un servicio a medida.
📍 Libro M7 p.5
questions.en:
Segmenting means dividing the market into groups with similar needs and offering each one a tailored service.
📍 Book M7 p.5

questions.q: A transport company removes two levels of middle management. What is a likely disadvantage?
questions.es:
Una estructura más plana mejora la comunicación y baja los costes, pero hay menos ascensos y cada jefe supervisa a más gente.
📍 Libro M8 p.2
questions.en:
A flatter structure improves communication and lowers costs, but there are fewer promotions and each manager supervises more people.
📍 Book M8 p.2

questions.q: An employee asks for a copy of all the personal data the company holds about him. Within what time must the company normally reply?
questions.es:
Es una solicitud de acceso (GDPR): por regla general hay que responder en 1 mes (30 días) y sin coste.
📍 Libro M17 p.5
questions.en:
It is a subject access request (GDPR): as a rule the reply is due within 1 month (30 days), free of charge.
📍 Book M17 p.5

questions.q: A city bus driver on a 20 km regular route starts work at 06:00. Under the domestic rules, what is the latest he can finish his working day (spreadover)?
questions.es:
Las líneas regulares de hasta 50 km siguen las normas domésticas: la jornada completa (spreadover) es de 16 horas como máximo: 06:00 + 16 h = 22:00.
📍 Libro M11 p.10-11
questions.en:
Regular services up to 50 km follow the domestic rules: the whole working day (spreadover) is 16 hours at most: 06:00 + 16 h = 22:00.
📍 Book M11 p.10-11

questions.q: A vehicle's annual fixed costs are €54,000. Using the book's working year, what is the fixed cost per day?
questions.es:
El libro usa 225 días de trabajo (5 días × 45 semanas): 54.000 ÷ 225 = €240 al día. Dividir entre 365 (€148) es un error típico.
📍 Libro M14 p.12
questions.en:
The book uses 225 working days (5 days × 45 weeks): 54,000 ÷ 225 = €240 a day. Dividing by 365 (€148) is a typical mistake.
📍 Book M14 p.12

questions.q: When must a new heavy commercial vehicle take its first CVRT?
questions.es:
Primera CVRT al cumplir 1 año desde la matriculación y después cada 12 meses.
📍 Libro M19 p.2
questions.en:
First CVRT when it is 1 year old from registration, and then every 12 months.
📍 Book M19 p.2

questions.q: A driver cannot produce his insurance certificate when a Garda asks for it. What happens?
options: Produce it at a named station in 10 days
Show it at any station within 24 hours
Nothing, if the vehicle is taxed
questions.es:
Tiene 10 días para presentarlo en persona en la comisaría que le indiquen; la Garda también puede comprobarlo en la base de datos IMID.
📍 Libro M24 p.2
questions.en:
He has 10 days to produce it in person at the Garda station named; the Garda can also check it on the IMID database.
📍 Book M24 p.2

questions.q: A dominant operator cuts its prices below cost, only on the route where a new rival has started, to push it out. This is:
questions.es:
Precios por debajo del coste con intención de echar al competidor: abuso de posición dominante (sección 5 y artículo 102). Tener posición dominante no es ilegal; abusar de ella, sí.
📍 Libro M29 p.4
questions.en:
Prices below cost intended to drive out the competitor: abuse of a dominant position (section 5 and Article 102). Having a dominant position is not illegal; abusing it is.
📍 Book M29 p.4

questions.q: A company with 120 employees plans 15 redundancies within 30 days. Is it a collective redundancy?
questions.es:
De 100 a 299 empleados el umbral es el 10 %: 12 personas. 15 lo supera: despido colectivo, con al menos 30 días de consulta y aviso al Ministro.
📍 Libro M3 p.13
questions.en:
With 100 to 299 employees the threshold is 10%: 12 people. 15 is more: a collective redundancy, with at least 30 days of consultation and notice to the Minister.
📍 Book M3 p.13

questions.q: On an analogue chart, the distance trace shows 8 complete 'V' shapes. How far did the vehicle travel?
questions.es:
Cada trazo son 5 km, así que cada 'V' completa son 10 km: 8 × 10 = 80 km.
📍 Libro M12 p.8
questions.en:
Each stroke is 5 km, so each complete 'V' is 10 km: 8 × 10 = 80 km.
📍 Book M12 p.8

questions.q: What can a court impose for serious vehicle roadworthiness offences?
options: A written warning, never a fine
A fine of up to €500, no prison
Up to 5 years in prison and a ban
questions.es:
Multas de hasta €5.000, posible cárcel de hasta 6 meses, puntos y prohibición de usar el vehículo.
📍 Libro M20 p.3
questions.en:
Fines of up to €5,000, possible prison of up to 6 months, penalty points and a ban on using the vehicle.
📍 Book M20 p.3

questions.q: A bus route takes 40 minutes each way, with a 5-minute layover at each end. How many buses are needed for a 15-minute headway?
questions.es:
(40 + 5) × 2 = 90 minutos por vuelta ÷ 15 de headway = 6 autobuses.
📍 Libro M30 p.3
questions.en:
(40 + 5) × 2 = 90 minutes per round trip ÷ a 15-minute headway = 6 buses.
📍 Book M30 p.3

questions.q: A supplier will only deliver once it has been paid. Which document does it send first?
questions.es:
La factura pro-forma se usa cuando se exige el pago por adelantado.
📍 Libro M6 p.2
questions.en:
A pro-forma invoice is used when payment in advance is required.
📍 Book M6 p.2

questions.q: Two drivers share a vehicle (multi-manning). Within each period of 30 hours, how much daily rest must each of them take?
questions.es:
Con doble tripulación, cada conductor descansa al menos 9 horas en cada periodo de 30 horas, con el vehículo parado.
📍 Libro M11 p.3
questions.en:
With multi-manning, each driver rests at least 9 hours in each 30-hour period, with the vehicle stationary.
📍 Book M11 p.3

questions.q: A transport business that supplies services must register for VAT once its yearly turnover exceeds:
questions.es:
Servicios: €42.500 al año; bienes: €85.000. Por debajo se puede registrar de forma voluntaria.
📍 Libro M9 p.6
questions.en:
Services: €42,500 a year; goods: €85,000. Below that you can register voluntarily.
📍 Book M9 p.6

questions.q: A company's transport manager is convicted of a serious offence. When must the operator tell the Department in writing?
options: 3 months after the appeal period ends
Only when the licence is renewed
questions.es:
Por escrito, en los 3 meses siguientes a que termine el plazo de recurso (o a que se resuelva o retire el recurso). No hacerlo es delito.
📍 Libro M10 p.8
questions.en:
In writing, within 3 months of the end of the appeal period (or of the appeal being decided or withdrawn). Failing to do so is an offence.
📍 Book M10 p.8

questions.q: Under a 'nil defect' reporting system, what does a driver who finds nothing wrong at the daily check do?
options: Waits for a mechanic to check
questions.es:
Con el sistema 'Nil', el conductor entrega su hoja todos los días aunque no haya defectos; así el operador puede demostrar que las revisiones se hicieron.
📍 Libro M13 p.3 y p.8
questions.en:
With the 'Nil' system, the driver hands in the sheet every day even when there are no defects; that way the operator can show the checks were done.
📍 Book M13 p.3 and p.8

questions.q: Which of these is NOT an accident that must be reported under section 106 of the Road Traffic Act 1961?
questions.es:
La lista de animales es caballo, vaca, asno, mula, oveja, cerdo, cabra y perro: el gato no está. Dañar un coche aparcado o bienes junto a la carretera sí cuenta.
📍 Libro M23 p.1
questions.en:
The list of animals is horse, cattle, ass, mule, sheep, pig, goat and dog: a cat is not on it. Damaging a parked car or property beside the road does count.
📍 Book M23 p.1

questions.q: Which source of finance is NOT suitable for buying vehicles?
questions.es:
El descubierto es financiación a corto plazo para el día a día; para comprar vehículos se usan préstamos a largo plazo, compra a plazos, leasing o beneficios guardados.
📍 Libro M5 p.3
questions.en:
An overdraft is short-term finance for day-to-day needs; vehicles are bought with long-term loans, hire purchase, leasing or retained profits.
📍 Book M5 p.3

questions.q: Under a gross cost bus contract, who keeps the fare revenue?
questions.es:
Gross cost: la autoridad se queda la recaudación y paga al operador su coste. Net cost: el operador se queda la recaudación y pide una subvención.
📍 Libro M31 p.4
questions.en:
Gross cost: the authority keeps the takings and pays the operator its cost. Net cost: the operator keeps the takings and asks for a subsidy.
📍 Book M31 p.4

questions.q: Which of these is NOT essential for a valid contract?
questions.es:
Un contrato puede ser verbal: los elementos esenciales son oferta y aceptación, consideration, capacidad, intención y legalidad.
📍 Libro M2 p.1
questions.en:
A contract can be verbal: the essential elements are offer and acceptance, consideration, capacity, intention and legality.
📍 Book M2 p.1

questions.q: What is the motorway speed limit for a coach that carries no standing passengers?
questions.es:
Autocar sin pasajeros de pie: 100 km/h en autopista y autovía y 80 en carreteras normales; con pasajeros de pie, 65 en todas.
📍 Libro M22 p.1
questions.en:
Coach without standing passengers: 100 km/h on motorways and dual carriageways and 80 on ordinary roads; with standing passengers, 65 on all roads.
📍 Book M22 p.1

questions.q: A mobile worker may work up to how many hours in a single week, provided the average stays at 48?
questions.es:
Media de 48 horas a la semana (normalmente en 4 meses), y nunca más de 60 en una sola semana.
📍 Libro M11 p.6
questions.en:
An average of 48 hours a week (normally over 4 months), and never more than 60 in a single week.
📍 Book M11 p.6

questions.q: Which insurance covers the employer against claims from staff injured at work?
questions.es:
Responsabilidad del empresario (Employers' Liability): lesiones de los empleados. Los daños a terceros en el local son Public Liability; la deshonestidad de los empleados, fidelity guarantee.
📍 Libro M24 p.10-11
questions.en:
Employer's Liability: injuries to employees. Damage to third parties on the premises is Public Liability; employee dishonesty is fidelity guarantee.
📍 Book M24 p.10-11

questions.q: Total annual costs are €500,000 and the company wants a profit of €40,000. What mark-up on cost is needed?
questions.es:
Recargo = beneficio × 100 ÷ costes totales = 40.000 × 100 ÷ 500.000 = 8 %.
📍 Libro M14 p.10-11
questions.en:
Mark-up = profit × 100 ÷ total costs = 40,000 × 100 ÷ 500,000 = 8%.
📍 Book M14 p.10-11

questions.q: A coach company is hired by a factory, under a contract, to carry its workers to and from work. What type of service is this?
questions.es:
Servicio regular especial: una categoría concreta de pasajeros (trabajadores, estudiantes) con contrato entre el organizador y el transportista; a bordo, copia del contrato.
📍 Libro M10 p.20
questions.en:
Special regular service: a specific category of passengers (workers, students) under a contract between the organiser and the carrier; a copy of the contract is carried on board.
📍 Book M10 p.20

questions.q: Since what date has the Euro 6 emissions standard been compulsory for new heavy vehicles?
questions.es:
Euro 6 es obligatorio desde el 1 de enero de 2014 (tecnologías SCR y EGR, filtros de partículas).
📍 Libro M25 p.7
questions.en:
Euro 6 has been compulsory since 1 January 2014 (SCR and EGR technologies, particulate filters).
📍 Book M25 p.7

questions.q: A driver loses his driver card during a trip. Within how many days must he report it to the RSA?
questions.es:
Debe avisar a la RSA en un máximo de 7 días y, mientras tanto, imprimir al principio y al final de cada jornada; puede seguir así hasta 15 días naturales.
📍 Libro M12 p.3
questions.en:
He must tell the RSA within 7 days at most and, in the meantime, print out at the start and end of each working day; he can continue like that for up to 15 calendar days.
📍 Book M12 p.3
